columns.name: workclass
columns.description: The individual's employment sector or work arrangement. The value '?' means the workclass is missing or unknown.

columns.name: fnlwgt
columns.description: The Census final sampling weight. It estimates how many people in the population are represented by this record; it is not personal income or wealth.

columns.name: education
columns.description: The highest educational qualification or grade level completed by the individual.

columns.name: education-num
columns.description: An ordered numeric encoding of educational attainment. Larger values represent higher education levels; this largely duplicates the information in 'education'.

columns.name: occupation
columns.description: The individual's occupation or main type of work. The value '?' means the occupation is missing or unknown.

columns.name: relationship
columns.description: The individual's role or relationship within the household.

columns.name: race
columns.description: The race category recorded for the individual.

columns.name: sex
columns.description: The sex category recorded for the individual.

columns.name: capital-gain
columns.description: Reported capital gains in US dollars. Most records have a value of 0, while nonzero values may strongly indicate higher income.

columns.name: capital-loss
columns.description: Reported capital losses in US dollars. Most records have a value of 0.

columns.name: hours-per-week
columns.description: The typical number of hours the individual works per week.

columns.name: native-country
columns.description: The individual's reported country of birth or origin. The value '?' means the country is missing or unknown.

columns.name: label
columns.description: The target label: '>50K' means annual income is greater than $50,000, while '<=50K' means annual income is at most $50,000.

task_description: Predict whether an individual's annual income is greater than $50,000 using demographic, education, employment, household, and financial attributes.
label: label
